strategy.text: The model is rewritten, not migrated. No partial Lean tree builds, so the model slice is indivisible; and because the simulator is a hand transcription, that slice is green on its own gate and red on the simulator by construction.

slices.text: Two slices: the model with its generators, tooling and Lean-derived pages; then the simulator and its pages, transcribed from the frozen interface by a different author.

staffing-checked-against-the-operators-r.text: The model slice is authored by GLM, the simulator slice by Muse, and every auditor is a fresh Opus seat with its own context, root, worktree and pane. Both launchers resolve in a non-interactive shell, so no escalation is needed.

constraints.text: Lean is the behavioral authority; a proved weaker statement is the wrong contract. Nothing lands or is pushed red, and the model checker is opened to new identities without being relaxed.

invariant-rows-slice-a.text: Each row binds a Lean identity, a given-when-then, the executable observation that exhibits it, and a control able to fail for the intended reason.

definitions.text: Nine definition rows, from the alphabet and the removed vocabulary through the edges, the read, admission, the fold's refusals, and where each token and its value goes.

codec-frozen-sibling-contract-for-157-an.text: Three codec rows: the round trip, the refusal of every byte that is not one of the three, and the refusal of naming-era leaf bytes.

statements-interface-6-and-4.text: The eleven promises at their bound identities: policing, atomicity, soundness, permanence, synchronisation, occupancy, termination, and the four laws of the witnesses.

instances.text: The open application first, as the proof that the guarantees are unconditional in the application; then naming, whose trie-free moves must leave the root equal.

mutants-the-four-named-in-154.text: Each mutant must elaborate first, so what is measured is a semantic change and not a syntax error; the kill is either a statement whose proof no longer closes or a corpus row whose verdict flips, recorded per mutant with a positive control. A compile failure alone is not a behavioral kill.

invariant-rows-slice-b-163.text: Seven simulator rows: the edges and the read exposed, every illegal combination refused by name, full replay agreement, the naming profile's Over witness, counts equal to what replays, fresh speech, and a clarity record.

gates.text: Three frozen gates: a focused model gate that deliberately does not claim the repository green, a focused simulator gate, and the ticket gate on the combined tree, which is the only one that may.

evidence-required-at-acceptance.text: Fresh command receipts, a clean axiom report, the four mutants with their controls, regenerated corpora and pages, two independent audit reports, and green continuous integration on the one head that is ever pushed.
